title: Quick interop rollup slate - compact cross-team tally
content:
Context:
A short one-pager + compact spreadsheet for today's cross-functional triage slot. Single sheet to share in the 11:00 standup \u2014 focus on quick ownership handoffs and minimal data (no heavy scoring).

Goal: produce a 1st-pass list that ops/product/eng can scan in <3 mins and act on. Keep columns minimal so people actually update in Slack.

Legend: P0 = immediate, P1 = target this sprint, P2 = backlog; COV = estimated coverage impact (low/med/high)

-- Compact table (paste into drive sheet) --
RowID,Item,Owner,Team,Priority,ETA,COV,Status,Notes
1,Regional fallback test flaky - eu-west-2,Ravi Shah,infra,P1,2026-05-10,high,in-progress,Intermittent 503s during burst - see ENG-11234; tentative fix in infra PR 482
2,Endpoint quota mismatch for partner-beta,Maya Lin,customer-success,P0,2026-05-05,high,blocked,Partner reported undercounting usage; needs request logs from hosted-api team
3,Canary rollout telemetry oddball,DAN-telemetry-alerts,eng-observability,P1,2026-05-12,med,open,Missing spans for a subset of requests >4s; correlate with KV cache misses
4,Docs: Dedicated capacity pricing snippet outdated,Aisha Martinez,product,P2,2026-05-21,low,assigned,Quick copy update + screenshots; low risk
5,Private deployment onboarding checklist gap - KMS keys,Daniel O'Connor,private-deployments,P1,2026-05-14,high,in-review,Customer asked for HSM flow detail; consolidate with security checklist
6,Temporary burst cap request - customer ACME-Corp,Samir Patel,solutions,P0,2026-05-04,high,done,Manual allocation done; follow-up invoice adjustment pending
7,Embedding cost regression triage,Emilia Park,observability,P1,2026-05-11,med,open,Spike shows 12% token cost bump; likely quantization parameter drift
8,SLA exception for partner X - latency spike,Phoebe Tran,customer-success,P0,2026-05-04,high,monitoring,Windowed degradation during 02:00-03:00 PST; region failover configs applied
9,Rollout pause checklist - auto-revert missing flag,Ravi Shah,platform-engineering,P1,2026-05-13,med,open,Need flag to enable system-level auto-reverts when config mismatch occurs
10,Small spike-run playbook refresh,Maya Lin,product-ops,P2,2026-05-28,low,assigned,Add quick links to runbooks and owner roster

Quick tallies (for standup):
- Total rows: 10
- P0s: 3 (rows 2,6,8)
- P1s: 5
- P2s: 2
- High COV: 5
- Blocked: 1
- In-progress: 2
- Done: 1

Notes to self / open questions:
- Blocker (row 2) needs immediate logs; @Maya to ping hosted-api #prod-ops and post trace ids in the ticket.
- Quick ask: can infra add a tiny log-level toggle (30s window) to capture full KV cache state during a 503? Cost OK if temporary. (Ravi to propose in PR 482 comments)
- For telemetry oddball, we need to confirm whether missing spans are tied to new kernel selection changes rolled last week. Linking to ENG-11190 for context.

Communication plan:
- Post this sheet to #ops-standup 10 minutes before the meeting. Owners to reply with a single-line update (ETA or DONE).
- If a P0 is blocked after standup, escalate to oncall lead and tag in the sheet with timestamped comment.

Mini retrospective (fast):
- What worked: single-sheet minimal columns got much higher edit rate in last run.
- What didn't: long notes in "Notes" get ignored; keep bullets and add explicit asks.

Action items (short):
- Maya: get logs for row 2 by EOD 2026-05-04.
- Ravi: post proposed short-term log toggle in PR 482 and estimate cost impact by 2026-05-06.
- Daniel: finalize HSM onboarding paragraph and send to security for review by 2026-05-12.

References & quick links:
- ENG-11234 (infra issue)
- ENG-11190 (kernel selection rollout)
- PR 482: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/interop-rollups

Raw scratch notes (feel free to delete after 1 day):
- Might try making a single-cell status emoji column next time (green/yellow/red) to help scanning.
- Consider automated Slack bot that posts P0 rows into #escalations channel (later).
- Paper trail: copy this sheet into product-ops folder when final
